conversation.content: Describe what it is like to run on a GPU. Two sentences, be honest.

Running on a GPU is like handing a massive, parallel spreadsheet to a team of specialists who can process data much faster than a single person could, drastically accelerating complex calculations. It feels incredibly smooth and responsive, especially with graphics-intensive tasks, but it can also be frustrating when tasks aren't efficiently optimized for parallel processing.
